delay_slot_policy: the shared neutral layers have no MIPS32 delay-slot concept: call delay slots are the CALL_RETURN continuation, branch delay slots are the BRANCH_NOT_TAKEN successor, and jump/return/indirect-jump delay slots are explicit orphan blocks neither owned by a function nor silently dropped; true delay-slot execution semantics stay in the P3-03/P3-04 frontier and the later runtime stages
